name: Raised Crosswalk Locations
description: This dataset lists raised crosswalk locations, with 159 sampled records and six columns. Each row represents a single raised crosswalk treatment, identified by a treatment type, a date, a node ID, and point geometry. The treatment column is mostly "Raised Crosswalk" (about 89%), with smaller shares for variants such as raised crosswalks on specific intersection legs, mid-block raised crosswalks, and other leg-specific labels. The date field records when each entry was logged or installed, spanning multiple years. The nodeid column gives a numeric network node reference for most records, and wkt_geometry stores each location as a point in well-known text format. The x and y columns provide the same coordinates as separate numeric fields, with x ranging roughly from 927,000 to 1,063,000 and y from 131,000 to 267,000, suggesting a projected coordinate system rather than latitude and longitude. A small number of records are missing node ID or geometry values
